title: Double Drip Lemon & Lime Nic Salt 10ml E-Liquid
description: Double Drip Lemon and Lime delivers a classic citrus combo that’s as clean and punchy as it is refreshing. Zesty Lemon brings a tangy brightness, while Lime adds a juicy, slightly sweet twist to balance the sharpness. The combination creates a lively fruit vape with a crisp finish that’s ideal for citrus lovers seeking a bold but balanced profile. Formulated with nicotine salts for faster nicotine absorption and a smoother throat hit, this e-liquid is blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio and designed for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping. It performs best in low-powered pod kits, vape pens, and starter devices, offering consistent flavour and discreet vapour production. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, Double Drip Nic Salts are available in a wide range of bold and satisfying flavour profiles to suit everyday vaping. Double Drip are one of the most celebrated and influential e-liquid brands in the UK and the masterminds of some of the most iconic vape flavours ever made. Vibrant, authentic, and highly inventive flavours are a hallmark of all Double Drip vape juices, and this newest collection of truly timeless flavours in smooth, satisfying nic salts won’t disappoint.
